DELAY_PLUGIN.doc: The delay plugin's parameters, in append-only order: DPF's parameter index is the CLAP param id and the LV2 port order (omx-plugins-dpf §3b). Moved from openmixer's packages/omx-plugins/tools/params-gen.mjs PLUGINS.delay.
DELAY_PLUGIN.why: mix is per instance on the desk (insert or fxReturn); a plugin racked in a foreign host is an INSERT, so it reads the input kind's default (omx-plugins-dpf §3a).
DELAY_PLUGIN.source: FX_DELAY_TIME_RANGE, FX_DELAY_FEEDBACK_RANGE, DELAY_MIX_RANGE for kind input, DELAY_TONE_RANGE, FX_DELAY_PINGPONG_DEFAULT
